page.overview:
Who is Ball Guy?

Ball Guy is the official mascot of the Pokémon League (Galar). It is depicted as a person with a Poké Ball shaped head who gifts different kinds of Poké Balls to Trainers.

A person wearing a Ball Guy costume can be found hanging around stadiums across the region.

The Ball Guy character is depicted as a humanoid person with white skin and a large Poké Ball head, which has big eyes, a buck tooth, a gray hat, and a red turf of "hair". The Ball Guy wears a red shirt and gray short pants and shoes that resemble a Poké Ball.

The real face of the person wearing the Ball Guy costume is unknown, as they always wear the Ball Guy mask. Strangely, their skin tone is also white, just like the character.
